_provenance.note: Queue QLen/RespT/ResidT updated 2026-07-22 when Pareto.evalLST was corrected. The previous golden 0.74758 was NOT the exact G/M/1 answer: evalLST was a 1000-point right-endpoint rectangle sum truncated at k*1000^(1/alpha), which returned A*(0)=0.96914 (it lost 3.1% of the probability mass) and biased the sigma root low. Both goldens are compared against an independently computed reference below; the new value is closer, which is the criterion for replacing it.

exact_reference.model: Par/M/1, Pareto.fitMeanAndSCV(1,64) -> alpha=2.0077822185, k=0.5019380136, mu=2, rho=0.5
exact_reference.method: G/M/1 caudal root of sigma = A*(mu(1-sigma)) with A*(s)=alpha*(s*k)^alpha*Gamma(-alpha,s*k) evaluated in mpmath at 120 digits; scipy brentq to 1e-15

_provenance.agreement: MATLAB, PYTHON and MATLAB-WRAPPER all report 0.7837 after the fix
